sentences.ar: راح توم للخالة بولي وقال: خلصت السور.
sentences.en: Tom went to Aunt Polly and said: I finished the fence.

sentences.ar: ما صدقت، وطلعت تشوف، وشافت السور أبيض زي التلج.
sentences.en: She did not believe him, went out to see, and saw the fence white as snow.

sentences.ar: قالت: توم، إنت بتقدر تشتغل لما بدك.
sentences.en: She said: Tom, you can work when you want to.

sentences.ar: بس نادراً ما بدك.
sentences.en: But you rarely want to.

sentences.ar: وأعطته تفاحة، ودرس عن قيمة الشغل.
sentences.en: And she gave him an apple, and a lesson on the value of work.

sentences.ar: توم أخد التفاحة، وسرق كعكة وهي بتحكي، وطلع.
sentences.en: Tom took the apple, stole a cake while she talked, and went out.

sentences.ar: مشى بالشارع، ومر قدام بيت القاضي تاتشر.
sentences.en: He walked down the street, and passed by Judge Thatcher's house.

sentences.ar: وبالحديقة، شاف بنت.
sentences.en: And in the garden, he saw a girl.

sentences.ar: بنت جديدة، ما شافها قبل، شعرها أصفر ومجدول، وفستانها أبيض.
sentences.en: A new girl, whom he had not seen before, her hair yellow and braided, her dress white.

sentences.ar: وتوم، اللي كان بيحب بنت اسمها آمي من شهور، نسي آمي بلحظة.
sentences.en: And Tom, who had loved a girl named Amy for months, forgot Amy in a moment.

sentences.ar: وقف عالسور، وبلش يعمل حركات.
sentences.en: He stood by the fence, and began doing tricks.

sentences.ar: وقف على إيديه، ومشى عالسور، ورمى حاله عالأرض.
sentences.en: He stood on his hands, walked along the fence, threw himself on the ground.

sentences.ar: والبنت ما تطلعت فيه.
sentences.en: And the girl did not look at him.

sentences.ar: وبعدين، وهي داخلة عالبيت، وقفت لحظة.
sentences.en: And then, as she went into the house, she stopped a moment.

sentences.ar: ورمت وردة من فوق السور، وفاتت.
sentences.en: And she threw a flower over the fence, and went in.

sentences.ar: توم ركض للوردة، ووقف جنبها، وعمل حاله بيدور على إشي.
sentences.en: Tom ran to the flower, stood beside it, and pretended to be looking for something.

sentences.ar: وبعدين رفعها بأصابع إجره، وحطها بجيبه، وراح.
sentences.en: And then he picked it up with his toes, put it in his pocket, and left.

sentences.ar: ورجع بالمسا، ووقف قدام البيت لحد ما إجا الليل.
sentences.en: And he came back in the evening, and stood in front of the house until night came.

sentences.ar: وبعدين تمدد تحت الشباك، وتخيل إنه مات، وهي بتبكي عليه.
sentences.en: And then he lay down under the window, and imagined he had died, and she was crying over him.

sentences.ar: وفجأة انفتح الشباك، وطلع منه دلو مي.
sentences.en: And suddenly the window opened, and a bucket of water came out of it.

sentences.ar: وقع على توم كله.
sentences.en: It fell on all of Tom.

sentences.ar: قام، ونفض حاله، وركض عالبيت وهو مبلول.
sentences.en: He got up, shook himself, and ran home soaked.

sentences.ar: وبالبيت، سيد قال: توم، ليش مبلول؟
sentences.en: And at home, Sid said: Tom, why are you wet?

sentences.ar: توم ما رد.
sentences.en: Tom did not answer.

sentences.ar: بس بالليل، رمى على سيد حجارة زغيرة وهو نايم.
sentences.en: But at night, he threw small stones at Sid while he slept.

sentences.ar: وحس إنه رد له الخيط الأسود.
sentences.en: And he felt he had paid him back for the black thread.
